Title: Azure Database for MySQL - Flexible Server is now generally available

Body.Content:
Flexible Server is a deployment option for Azure Database for MySQL that is best suited for mission critical application workloads with same zone or zone redundant high availability. This deployment option allows you to access custom maintenance windows to maximize your business uptime, predictable performance, and more cost optimization controls. 

Azure Database for MySQL - Flexible Server is a fully managed database service designed to provide more granular control and flexibility over database management functions and configuration settings. The Flexible Server architecture provides low latency, predictable performance, IOPS scaling independent of storage, and zone resiliency. Flexible Server also provides the ability to stop/start your server, burstable  compute, and Reserved Instance pricing - ideal for production workloads with cost savings up to 63%. The service is generally available today in a wide variety of Azure regions.  

Learn more.
